subtitle.zh: 模板：3 个块、2 条总线、1 个 flow

description.zh:
这是架构浏览器 JSON 的最小模板。复制本文件、改掉 id/title，再按 docs/arch/arch_explorer.md 中的 schema 添加 blocks / buses / flows 即可。

画布坐标为逻辑像素，建议 1200×700 以内；kind 决定配色并显示在图例中。

所有面向用户的文字既可以是普通字符串，也可以是 {"zh": "...", "en": "..."} 对象。
description.en:
This is the minimal template for an Architecture Explorer JSON file. Copy it, change id/title, then add blocks / buses / flows following the schema in docs/arch/arch_explorer.md.

Canvas coordinates are logical pixels, preferably within 1200×700; kind determines the colour and is shown in the legend.

Every user-visible text may be a plain string or a {"zh": "...", "en": "..."} object.

sublabel.zh: RV32I, 单发射 5 级流水

details.zh:
处理器核。通过数据总线访问内存，通过 MMIO 访问外设寄存器。

点击块后，这段 details 会显示在右侧栏；props 中的键值对显示在属性表里。
details.en:
The processor core. It accesses memory over the data bus and peripheral registers via MMIO.

When a block is clicked, this details text is shown in the details panel; the key/value pairs in props are shown in the property table.

details.zh: 指令与数据统一存放的主存。
details.en: Main memory holding both instructions and data.

details.zh: 串口外设：CPU 向 TX 寄存器写字节即发送。
details.en: Serial port peripheral: the CPU sends a byte by writing it to the TX register.

title.zh: CPU 通过 UART 发送一个字符
title.en: The CPU sends a character through the UART

description.zh: 演示最简单的 MMIO 访问路径。
description.en: Shows the simplest MMIO access path.

text.zh: CPU 从 RAM 取指并读取待发送的字符。
text.en: The CPU fetches instructions from RAM and reads the character to send.

text.zh: CPU 执行 sw 指令，把字符写入 UART 的 TX 寄存器（MMIO 地址）。
text.en: The CPU executes a sw instruction that writes the character to the UART's TX register (an MMIO address).

text.zh: UART 把字节串行发送出去；STATUS 寄存器在发送期间置 busy。
text.en: The UART shifts the byte out serially; the STATUS register reports busy while sending.
